validity.researcher_notes: Real, under construction (Astrakhan region, Gazprom programme). Sheet still says proposed/2023. Terminates at a gas collection point with offtakes to GRS Lenino/Enotaevka, to gasify Chernoyarsky district: a transmission-type offtake rather than distribution (flag, not reclassified; contested not set because candidate class needs owner decision). Length/diameter/capacity carry a ResearcherNote 2014 details; nothing newer found. Dec 2023 removal from federal planning scheme (seen only in a search snippet, unverified) may be worth checking. Not a duplicate of P3972 (different route, Yenotaevsky vs Kharabali/Akhtubinsk).
